--TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM,ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE,ACCT_POA_AS_NAME,ACCT_POA_AS_DESIG,ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS,ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD,START_DATE,END_DATE,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,CUST_ID,CUST_RELTN_CODE,PASS_SHEET_FLG,SI_FLG,TD_MATRTY_FLG,LOAN_OVRDUE_FLG,NMA_KEY_TYPE,NMA_KEY_ID,DEL_FLG,MODE_OF_DESPATCH,TS_CNT,SCHM_TYPE,XCLUDE_FOR_COMB_STMT,STMT_CUST_ID,INT_ADV_FLG,INTCERT_PRINT_FLG,GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT,GUARANTOR_LIAB_SEQ,INTRADAY_STMNT_REQD,BANK_ID,CUST_PHONE_TYPE,CUST_EMAIL_TYPE,RELATED_PARTY_TYPE,PROFIT_CERT_FLG,PREF_LANG_CODE,PREF_LANG_ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS,ALT1_ACCT_POA_AS_NAME,RPARTY_STMT_PRNT_CHRG_FLG,RPARTY_RGLR_STMT_CHRG_ID,RPARTY_DUP_STMT_CHRG_ID,WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE,WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE,WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE,TAX_CERT_NUM,TAX_FORM_PARTICULARS,TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE,ENTITY_CRE_FLG,TAX_EVENT,REQUESTED_BY,TAX_EVENT_REASON_CODE,TAX_MARKER,CORP_REP_CIF_ID,MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG,CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG,REASON_FOR_RELEASE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM,DEL_FLG
FROM (	SELECT [ACID]
,[ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM]
,[ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE]
,[ACCT_POA_AS_NAME]
,[ACCT_POA_AS_DESIG]
,[ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS]
,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD,' ',''),''),0)) as [ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[START_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as START_DATE
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[END_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as END_DATE
,[LCHG_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as LCHG_TIME
,[RCRE_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as RCRE_TIME
,[CUST_ID]
,[CUST_RELTN_CODE]
,[PASS_SHEET_FLG]
,[SI_FLG]
,[TD_MATRTY_FLG]
,[LOAN_OVRDUE_FLG]
,[NMA_KEY_TYPE]
,[NMA_KEY_ID]
,[DEL_FLG]
,[MODE_OF_DESPATCH]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(TS_CNT,' ',''),''),0)) as [TS_CNT]
,[SCHM_TYPE]
,[XCLUDE_FOR_COMB_STMT]
,[STMT_CUST_ID]
,[INT_ADV_FLG]
,[INTCERT_PRINT_FLG]
,convert(numeric(9,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT,' ',''),''),0)) as [GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT]
,[GUARANTOR_LIAB_SEQ]
,[INTRADAY_STMNT_REQD]
,[BANK_ID]
,[CUST_PHONE_TYPE]
,[CUST_EMAIL_TYPE]
,[RELATED_PARTY_TYPE]
,[PROFIT_CERT_FLG]
,[PREF_LANG_CODE]
,[PREF_LANG_ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS]
,[ALT1_ACCT_POA_AS_NAME]
,[RPARTY_STMT_PRNT_CHRG_FLG]
,[RPARTY_RGLR_STMT_CHRG_ID]
,[RPARTY_DUP_STMT_CHRG_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE
,[TAX_CERT_NUM]
,[TAX_FORM_PARTICULARS]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE
,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
,[TAX_EVENT]
,[REQUESTED_BY]
,[TAX_EVENT_REASON_CODE]
,[TAX_MARKER]
,[CORP_REP_CIF_ID]
,[MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG]
,[CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG]
,[REASON_FOR_RELEASE]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
FROM [D360].[STG_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP]
where H = 'D' 
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM,ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE,ACCT_POA_AS_NAME,ACCT_POA_AS_DESIG,ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS,ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD,START_DATE,END_DATE,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,CUST_ID,CUST_RELTN_CODE,PASS_SHEET_FLG,SI_FLG,TD_MATRTY_FLG,LOAN_OVRDUE_FLG,NMA_KEY_TYPE,NMA_KEY_ID,DEL_FLG,MODE_OF_DESPATCH,TS_CNT,SCHM_TYPE,XCLUDE_FOR_COMB_STMT,STMT_CUST_ID,INT_ADV_FLG,INTCERT_PRINT_FLG,GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT,GUARANTOR_LIAB_SEQ,INTRADAY_STMNT_REQD,BANK_ID,CUST_PHONE_TYPE,CUST_EMAIL_TYPE,RELATED_PARTY_TYPE,PROFIT_CERT_FLG,PREF_LANG_CODE,PREF_LANG_ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS,ALT1_ACCT_POA_AS_NAME,RPARTY_STMT_PRNT_CHRG_FLG,RPARTY_RGLR_STMT_CHRG_ID,RPARTY_DUP_STMT_CHRG_ID,WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE,WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE,WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE,TAX_CERT_NUM,TAX_FORM_PARTICULARS,TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE,ENTITY_CRE_FLG,TAX_EVENT,REQUESTED_BY,TAX_EVENT_REASON_CODE,TAX_MARKER,CORP_REP_CIF_ID,MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG,CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG,REASON_FOR_RELEASE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM,DEL_FLG
FROM	BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP
WHERE	isLatest = 1 
)	
--INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ACID,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM,BANK_ID,DEL_FLG,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACID,TGT.ACID) AS ACID
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM,TGT.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM) AS ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.DEL_FLG,TGT.DEL_FLG) AS DEL_FLG
	
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.DEL_FLG = 'Y' THEN 'DELETE'
	    WHEN TGT.ACID IS NULL AND TGT.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	ELSE 'UPDATE' END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
	
WHERE	(
	TGT.ACID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
OR	TGT.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
